_about: The home valley as a plan (Claude E, lane E, 21 Oct): what the shared kit's painter and the checks read. Written by scripts/art/regions/valley_plan.py; do not edit by hand. From the brief docs/vision/regions/home-valley-frostline-brackens.md (world plan v5.3, 8.2). World px on the 11264 x 6912 canvas; tiers are Claude G's world tiers (base_tier 0: the sea), traced from rectangles of 8 px cells so every outline is on the grid; each outline is its tier's top and everything higher; tops in screen space, each south face hanging 32 px a tier under its rim. The woodland is Claude A's golden screen (outline, exits and stands only); the Frostline and the Brackens are Claude F's, Fernhollow Claude H's, the land between and the sea beyond the box Claude G's.
